sloka: स तत् शस्त्रम् अनुप्राप्य न्यास रक्षण तत्परः ।वने तु विचरति एव रक्षन् प्रत्ययम् आत्मनः ॥३-९-१९॥
transliteration: sa tat śastram anuprāpya nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ ।vane tu vicarati eva rakṣan pratyayam ātmanaḥ ॥3-9-19॥

translations.english: Then while the sage was practising penance at the hermitage, he gave him that excellent sword to be kept in trust.
